series: HUD Small Area Fair Market Rent, 2 bedroom

j.1: SAFMR of dominant 2020 ZCTA (largest land-area overlap with tract; ZCTA treated as ZIP)
j.2: county FY2026 FMR 2BR fallback (non-metro county or ZIP not in SAFMR list)

legend.z: ZIP/ZCTA used (number; 5 digits in these states)
legend.c: county FIPS as number; left-pad to 5 digits

notes: The FY2026 SAFMR file covers metro (METRO*) and non-metro (NCNTY*) ZIPs. 10106 ZIPs appear in >1 HUD area nationally; the row whose HUD area matches the FMR area of the tract county is used, else the median across all rows for that ZIP. FY2027 SAFMRs (effective 2026-10-01) are in raw/hud/FY27_safmrs.xlsx.
